## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure given Industrials, Materials and Energy leadership; consider positioning toward DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to weak/high-multiple tech names showing confirmed BELOW TREND and monitor large-cap divergence for trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) showing relative strength.
